findings.title: Billed ICU and room days contradict discharge summary
findings.detail: The hospital bill charges for 3 days of ICU care and 1 day of semi-private room rent, whereas the discharge summary states that the patient was shifted to the ward on day 2 of admission.

quotes.quote: Shifted to the ward on day 2 of admission and remained stable in the ward until discharge.

findings.title: Pharmacy invoice date precedes prescription date
findings.detail: The pharmacy bill is dated 18 Oct 2024, but the prescription for the dispensed discharge medications was issued on 19 Oct 2024.
